body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one 1-unit area within 4 units. Until your next turn, it counts as difficult terrain for enemies.

surges.html: When this card's Contingency triggers against a creature, that creature burns 1 die.
Draw, conceal, place, or interact with one small carried or unattended item as part of this Action.

rider.title: TRAP CONTINGENCY
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Contingency. Trigger: An enemy willingly leaves the prepared area. Effect: It suffers -1 Defense until the start of its next turn.
rider.meta: EXPIRES: START OF YOUR NEXT TURN
